description_md: - **Token Optimization:** Profiling production LLM API endpoints to eliminate context bloat and rewrite prompt structures; reduced token consumption while integrating changes into live backends without service interruption.

- **Enterprise Orchestration:** Designing agent orchestration for an 800+ tenant platform on NVIDIA AI-Q; engineered MAS state handoffs, data pipelines, and CI/CD workflows mapped across 5 compliance frameworks (GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA).
- **Quality Assurance:** Formulated 10–70 automated test cases per feature sprint to validate hallucination rates and context grounding.

- **Backend Development:** Engineered 8+ REST API endpoints on AWS, cutting incident triage time by 40% via CloudWatch logging; built an offline-first SQLite synchronization layer handling 100+ daily transactions with zero data loss.
